spec.description:
Polyair Reflective is
an Australian-manufactured thermo-reflective insulation range engineered with an
advanced closed-cell polyethylene foam core laminated between pure aluminium
foil facings. Designed for roofs, walls, and sheds in residential and commercial
buildings, it provides a 3-in-1 thermal insulation, thermal break, and vapour
barrier. By reflecting up to 97% of radiant heat and delivering an in-situ
thermal break, it significantly reduces summer heat gain and prevents winter
heat loss.
features:
3-in-1 performance: thermal insulation, thermal
break, and vapour barrier

Pure aluminium reflective foil facings reflect up
to 97% of radiant heat

Cross-linked closed-cell polyethylene foam core
prevents moisture absorption

Provides compliant thermal break on steel-framed
roofs and walls

Anti-glare coating on one face for installer safety in bright
sunlight

Non-toxic, non-allergenic, and fiber-free with zero itch during
handling

Advanced foam cell structure resists delamination and moisture
degradation
Low Flammability Index compliant with AS 1530.2

Suitable for
bushfire-prone areas up to BAL-40 under AS 3959

Proudly Australian made for
local climate conditions

technical.value:
Cross-linked closed-cell polyethylene foam core laminated with pure
aluminium foil

Achieves R0.20+ thermal break on steel
framing
1350 mm width x 22.25 m length (30 m² per roll)

spec.fire:
Flammability Index ≤ 5 to
AS 1530.2; Suitable for roofs in bushfire BAL-12.5 to BAL-40 to AS 3959
spec.compliance:
AS/NZS 4859.1, AS/NZS 4200.1, AS 1530.2, AS 3959, NCC 2022 Volume
One and Two
spec.sustainability:
Fiber-free; non-allergenic; zero ODP; low VOC
emissions; 100% recyclable polymers
install:
Roll out Polyair over roof
purlins or wall framing with anti-glare face oriented outward toward the
installer

Ensure roll edges overlap by a minimum of 50mm (or butt join if
fully taped with 72mm foil tape)

Secure mechanically to steel or timber
framing using wafer-head self-drilling screws with washers

Maintain a
minimum 20mm still air cavity adjacent to the reflective face to achieve rated
Total R-values

Tape all seams, joins, and penetrations with 72mm reinforced
aluminium foil tape to form a continuous vapour barrier

At roof eaves, allow
membrane to drain freely into gutters without ponding
selection_checklist:
Confirm required thermal break value (7-8mm thickness provides R0.20+ on
steel framing)

Verify minimum 20mm air space can be maintained in roof or
wall cavity

Calculate roll quantities (each roll covers 30m² allowing for
overlaps)
Order matching 72mm reinforced aluminium joining tape
limitations:
Requires a
minimum 20mm sealed airspace adjacent to foil face to achieve rated Total
R-value

Do not allow direct contact with wet concrete or alkaline mortar to
prevent foil corrosion

Not designed as a permanent foot-traffic surface or
exposed outdoor weather membrane

problem_keywords: thermal bridging on steel framing studs
hot metal roof space in summer
use_cases:
Installing over steel roof purlins and wall girts to provide a
compliant R0.20 thermal break in metal buildings

Radiant heat reflection and
condensation control in domestic garages, workshops, and rural steel sheds
Thermal barrier insulation under corrugated metal roofs in residential homes
not_for:
Cold climate wall cavities requiring Class 4 vapour-permeable
wraps
retrieval.rag_summary:
Polyair Reflective (Polyair Performa) is an
Australian-made 3-in-1 reflective insulation, thermal break, and Class 2 vapour
barrier manufactured from closed-cell polyethylene foam laminated between pure
aluminium foil facings. Reflecting up to 97% of radiant heat and providing a
certified R0.20+ thermal break on steel framing, it stops condensation and
reduces solar heat gain across roofs, walls, and sheds. Tested to AS 1530.2 with
a low Flammability Index (≤ 5, BAL-40 compliant), it provides a durable,
fiber-free thermal solution.
